name: HIGH HORNS
summary:
HIGH HORNS is a co-op physics-based climbing game developed by the indie team at XORWIRE.

Embrace the power of your bloodline as a mountain goat and set off on a free-form journey across the towering, enigmatic mountains that call your name. Scale them via traditional bouldering, or alternatively bewildering contraptions, these mountains are yours to conquer!

Leap bounds atop the mountains, reaping your rewards as either a a daring foe, or a collaborator amongst your fellow goat, all the while witnessing
